pages.text: Test the child condition at successive depths below the current position. Any passing depth succeeds; an optional depth index is available.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 1 per position actually checked, plus its condition.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 + L(n)*C, using the maximum position count n and attached condition cost C.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
